name: EPIC 247498294
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 13, 17.7 solar radii and 1.64 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 247498294 (K2 campaign 13): PARAM radius (solar radii) 17.740953 (16th-84th percentiles 16.633536-19.00708), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 247498294: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4682.4204 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 247498294 (K2 campaign 13): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 6255 (16th-84th percentiles 5947.34375-6754.921875), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 1.08 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the colour routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 6,255 parsecs away, 18 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 13, give 1.64 solar masses and 17.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,682 K at its surface.
